programs.title: Master of Business Administration (Competency Based-CB)

requirements.title: Managerial Accounting & Legal Aspects of Business

admissionRequirements: Admission requires either an approved business/business-management degree and at least three equivalent full-time years of relevant business administrative, operational, leadership or management experience in the past ten years, or an approved degree in another discipline and at least five such years. The university reviews degree accreditation or foreign equivalency.
A 2.5 cumulative GPA on the transcript for the conferred degree is required. Transfer grades from another institution are excluded from this admission GPA.

quotes.text: Apply now
While widely available, not all programs are available to residents of all states. Please check with a University Enrollment Representative.
Students cannot waive any courses in the required course of study using transfer activities, or any UOPX coursework from outside of this competency-based program.

Additional Admission Requirements for the MBA-CB All applicants are expected to meet the following admission requirements: • Must have completed one of the following: • A bachelor's degree, or higher, in business or business management from a college or university with approved institutional accreditation, or that is a candidate for approved institutional accreditation, or comparable bachelor's degree earned at a recognized foreign institution. If the institution became accredited while the applicant was attending, a minimum of 75% of the coursework taken toward the degree must have been completed while the institution was accredited or during the candidacy period. In addition, a minimum equivalent of three years of full-time professional administrative, operational, leadership, or management experience work experience within the past ten years in a business-related environment. • A bachelor's degree, or higher, in any discipline, from a college or university with approved institutional accreditation, or candidate for accreditation, or comparable bachelor's degree earned at a recognized foreign institution or a master's degree from an ABA accredited institution (i.e., JD, LLB, LLM). If the institution became accredited while the applicant was attending, a minimum of 75% of the coursework taken toward the degree must have been completed while the institution was accredited or during the candidacy period. In addition, a minimum equivalent of five years of full-time professional administrative, operational, leadership, or management experience work experience within the past ten years in a business-related environment. • A cumulative GPA of 2.5 for all coursework listed on the degree posted transcript at the same level as the conferred degree (i.e., bachelor's, master's, or doctoral) is required for admission. Transfer coursework that was earned outside of the institution that conferred the degree will not be calculated into the cumulative GPA for admissibility.
$300 per credit (no additional fees)
Take 3 to 4 courses at your own pace every 16-week period.
Self-paced, flexible learnings with limited faculty guidance
Completion of 33 credits consisting of 11 different courses
